messages:
tanya: Quick postmortem follow-up  biggest asks: a minimal guardrail that infra can enforce (containment window, auto-actions), clear owners for remediation items, and a recurrence fingerprint so analytics can spot repeats.

mike: Agreed. We keep getting noisy canaries that don't trip until late. Proposal: micro-canary staging (0.5%) + immediate probe sampling + a 3-check signature rule (error spike, latency tail, fidelity drop).

indra: Suggest definition: error_spike = error_rate >= 3x baseline over 5m; latency_tail = p99 >= 2.5x baseline over 5m; fidelity_drop = probe_eval_drop >= 2.5% on 200 probes. 2/3 -> quarantine; 3/3 -> immediate rollback.

sloane: Also add a hard blast-radius cap per-flag (default 5%) and an emergency cap (1%) enforced by runtime unless an approver overrides. That protects prod even with misconfigured flags.

tanya: Draft gating config to store with deploys. We'll attach gating_config_id to deployment events so postmortems can point at exact policy. Example JSON (runtime reads this):

```
{
  "gating_config_id": "g-1937-01",
  "flag": "reply-lite",
  "phases": ["0.5%","2%","10%","100%"],
  "phase_timeout_mins": 60,
  "containment_window_mins": 12,
  "micro_sample_pct": 0.5,
  "emergency_cap_pct": 1,
  "signatures": {
    "error_spike": {"multiplier": 3.0, "window_mins":5},
    "latency_tail": {"p99_multiplier": 2.5, "window_mins":5},
    "fidelity_probe": {"eval_set":"probe_small_v3","drop_pct":2.5}
  },
  "auto_sequence": ["quarantine","fallback_pin","rollback"],
  "fingerprint_fields": ["flag","variant","signature_id"]
}
```

mike: Runtime behavior notes: quarantine pins 90% to previous stable variant, routes 10% to canary with doubled probe sampling. fallback_pin holds promotions for containment_window_mins and if signature persists then rollback. Also provide a 'degrade' action that pins 95% and reduces model capacity.

indra: Telemetry we need: counters `guard.quarantine`, `guard.fallback_pin`, `guard.rollback`, gauge `guard.quarantine_duration`, and event `guard.fingerprint` containing `sha1(flag|variant|signature_id)`. Analytics will group by fingerprint for recurrence.

sloane: Ownership & timelines:
- tanya: write the RFC + canonical gating examples (due: 4 business days)
- mike: implement runtime enforcement (emergency cap, quarantine, fallback_pin) (due: 2 weeks)
- indra: probe-set + eval integration + baseline snapshots (due: 8 days)
- sloane: recurrence dashboard + weekly recurrence job + calendar automation (due: 3 weeks)

ops-bot: REMINDER: PRs modifying rollout defaults must include `./ci/guardrail_smoke.sh` and attach `deployment.gating_config_id` to deployment audit events. Merge blocked if smoke fails.

mike: Small UX: add `hold_until_approval` flag per-gating-config. When true, phases don't promote automatically and require console approval. Also emit counter `guard.hold_approved` on human approval.

indra: For recurrence semantics: run weekly job that surfaces any fingerprint with >1 occurrence in 90 days and auto-open a review task for owners. If a fingerprint recurs twice without rollback, escalate severity and require a manual mitigation plan.

tanya: I'll file the RFC + PRs today and attach the example gating JSON. If no objections I'll tag owners and set the due dates.

sloane: No objections. ack on calendar/recurrence automation.

mike: ack. starting runtime branch tomorrow.

indra: ack. will prep probes and snapshots.

tanya: thanks all  I'll post links when RFC + tickets are ready.
